summary: R199 is a no-patch Paper 06 survival package for known RA67 source-marker repairs and RA48 p191-p196 tail display/source-apparatus repairs. It verifies that p161/p164/p165 source-style markers, p191 equation/source-note apparatus, p193-p194 left-numbered source displays, p195 source-style Hilbert extension note, and p196 no-fix traps survive in the current cumulative.
public_caveat: Targeted source-anchor survival/provenance only. No new TeX patch, not full Paper 06 certification, not source closure, not corpus certification, not multilingual synchronization, and not critical-edition material. Tail crop files are labelled 1000dpi review crops but derive from native 400ppi GDZ tail pages; use them as review/source-navigation evidence, not as native 1000ppi source capture.
